# Six-Week Trial of Reserved Pediatric Appointments

Starting August 5, Northside Community Clinic will reserve 12 same-day appointment slots each weekday for urgent pediatric cases. The clinic is running this six-week trial because, during the previous four weeks, 18 caregivers who called about a sick child were told that no same-day appointment was available.

Caregivers may request a same-day slot by calling the clinic. No app or online account is required. A triage nurse—not front-desk staff—will decide whether the case is urgent using the clinic’s existing triage protocol. A same-day appointment is not guaranteed.

Any reserved slots not used that day will be released to online booking at 14:00 for next-day appointments.

During the trial, the clinic will measure pediatric waiting time and abandoned calls. The trial does not add clinicians or increase the clinic’s total appointment capacity, and it does not change the existing triage protocol. No decision has been made about continuing reserved slots after the six-week trial.
